Serving Omaha Metro

Keeping a lawn looking its best in the Omaha area is a year-round job. Between the scorching summer heat, the unpredictable spring storms, and the blanket of leaves in the fall, your yard goes through a lot. That’s where we come in. At A1, we’re not just a tree service and junk removal company; we’re your neighbors, and we know exactly what it takes to keep a lawn in Papillion, Bellevue, or anywhere else around here looking healthy and clean.

Proper lawn maintenance is more than just a quick mow every other week. It’s about giving your grass what it needs to thrive through every Nebraska season. It’s about proactive care that prevents problems before they start, saving you headaches and money down the road.

More Than Just a Quick Mow

A lot of folks think lawn maintenance just means cutting the grass when it gets too long. While our lawn mowing service is a big part of it, a truly healthy lawn needs more. Think of it like this: mowing is the haircut, but maintenance is the whole health and wellness plan. We handle the nitty-gritty details that make the difference between a so-so yard and one that makes the rest of the block jealous.

Photo coming soon

What Our Lawn Maintenance Plan Covers

When you have us handle your lawn maintenance, you’re getting a complete package. We don’t just show up and run a mower over your yard. We take a look at what your specific lawn needs and build a plan around it. Here’s what a typical maintenance plan with A1 looks like:

Consistent Mowing & Edging

We’ll keep your grass at the perfect height for the season and create those clean, sharp edges along sidewalks and driveways.

Targeted Fertilizing

Your lawn needs food. We apply the right fertilizer at the right time to encourage strong roots and lush, green growth.

Seasonal Aeration

Compacted soil is a big problem in our area. Aeration gives your lawn’s roots room to breathe, drink, and grow deep.

Proactive Weed Control

We don’t wait for dandelions to take over. Our treatments target weeds before they become an eyesore, keeping your lawn looking uniform and clean.

Keeping Your Yard Healthy, No Matter the Season

In Nebraska, you can’t treat your lawn the same in May as you do in October. In the spring, it’s all about waking the grass up and getting ahead of weeds. Summer is about managing stress from the heat and ensuring it has enough water. And fall? That’s when we’re preparing it for the long winter, cleaning up leaves, and giving it one last boost. We adjust our approach as the seasons change, so your lawn is always getting the right care at the right time.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should my lawn be maintained?

For most of the growing season in Omaha, a weekly schedule is best for mowing to keep the lawn healthy and prevent stress. Other services like aeration and fertilizing happen just a few times a year. We'll work with you to set a schedule that makes sense for your specific yard and budget.

Is a maintenance plan cheaper than paying for services one by one?

Absolutely. Bundling services into a seasonal or annual plan almost always saves you money compared to scheduling each service individually. It also ensures your lawn gets consistent, proactive care, which prevents more expensive problems from developing later on.

Do I need to be home when you service my lawn?

Nope. As long as we have access to the areas we need to work on, you don't need to be there. We’ll do our work, clean up after ourselves, and you can come home to a perfectly maintained yard.

What's the difference between lawn maintenance and lawn mowing?

Lawn mowing is just the act of cutting the grass. Lawn maintenance is a comprehensive approach that includes mowing, but also fertilizing, weed control, aeration, and other treatments designed to keep your lawn healthy and thriving all year long.
